name: Dapiprazole
summary: Dapiprazole (brand name Rev-Eyes) is an alpha-1 blocker. It is used to reverse mydriasis after eye examination.

pharmacology.text: Dapiprazole (brand name Rev-Eyes) is an alpha-1 blocker.

uses.text: It is used to reverse mydriasis after eye examination.

sideEffects.en: It commonly causes red eyes and a burning or stinging feeling. It can also cause a drooping eyelid, headache and blurred vision.
sideEffects.zh: 它常造成眼睛發紅與灼熱或刺痛感，也可能造成眼皮下垂、頭痛與視力模糊。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它常造成眼睛发红与灼热或刺痛感，也可能造成眼皮下垂、头痛与视力模糊。

fact.en: Drops used to widen the pupil for an eye examination can leave vision blurred for a while. Dapiprazole narrows the pupil again by relaxing the muscle that pulls it open.
fact.zh: 眼睛檢查時用來放大瞳孔的眼藥水，可能讓視力模糊一段時間。Dapiprazole 會放鬆把瞳孔拉開的肌肉，讓瞳孔重新縮小。
fact.zhHans: 眼睛检查时用来放大瞳孔的眼药水，可能让视力模糊一段时间。Dapiprazole 会放松把瞳孔拉开的肌肉，让瞳孔重新缩小。
